description: Balance due subtracts every payment on Form 1040 line 33: withholding (line 25d), estimated tax payments (line 26) and the Form 4868 payment (line 31 via Schedule 3 line 13a). Single 2025: wages $100,000 → taxable income $84,250; Tax Table row $84,250–$84,300 (midpoint $84,275): $1,192.50 + 12% × $36,550 + 22% × $35,800 = $13,454.50 → $13,455. Withheld $9,000, estimated payments $3,000, extension payment $1,000 → balance due $455. (Subtracting withholding only gave $4,455.)
